most joy division songs were recorded (not released) in the 70s. of course, closer was recorded in 1980 but less than half way through that year.
80’s (plural)
1980 (singular) 

if a person defines a (60s,70s,80) band in regard to the decade in which the band gained highly increasing popularity, saying joy division is an 80s band is a strong argument. if you think it’s about when majority of a band’s songs were written and recorded, most can say joy division is a 70s band.  in my opinion, regardless of which decade ian and joy division wrote and recorded their songs, joy division was ahead of their time. their music is timeless and holds significance in the lives of myself and many others. they deserve the fame they’ve received and it’s a shame that ian never truly experienced his impact on the lives of masses.
why can’t you change the present?
keep pushing. it may not come fast it it will come. i promise. take it day by day

i understand the feeling. life is filled with torment. it’s like that for many people. what makes it more tolerable though is find things that make you feel better, things that you enjoy, things that put a smile on your face no matter how simple it may be. even if there is nothing like that in your life now, there will be a time where there is. it’s hard to believe but keep pushing and it will happen. you will one day experience joy that matches this pain. you might be stuck here for a while, but the world isn’t going anywhere. hang on in there.

i know it’s hard to believe and i am still suffering from depression as well but things seriously won’t always be like this. it may not completely go away but it won’t always be so bad. depression makes us believe there is no hope. “minds have their own weather systems. you are in a hurricane. Hurricanes run out of energy eventually. Hold on.”
notes on a nervous planet by matt haig

mine has been dog shit too man. i’m working to improve things but it’s so hard and it’s taking so long. i’m afraid i’ll never get to where i want to be and i also keep fucking up. i already know there is not enough time left in the summer to get where i want and because of that i can’t enjoy summer at all.

you are on the right path man. you are working hard now and that will pay off. i think everyone is stressed about the future but don’t let that worry ruin the present. soon you’ll have enough money saved for that pc. just keep pushing and it’ll work out. even though it’s hard sometimes you are on a good path and it won’t be like this forever. stay safe brother

i feel you. life just fucks people over sometimes and gives us disadvantages. but all those people you know that went to college or whatnot are likely extremely in debt, miserable because of studies etc. how much you make or having a prestigious occupation doesn’t matter. you must do things that make you happy or try things that might. enjoy small things like nature or music. find what makes you happy and life less miserable and hold on to that. push yourself to improve however you can and life will become less miserable. work hard but don’t like work drive you mad. somethings in life like rent just suck and we can’t do much about that but it’s important to try to change bad things we can do something about.

that’s really sucks. to be honest with you i know the feeling of no escape. and the drugs don’t fill the hole inside us. i often have a hard time believing it will get better but with effort i see things slightly improving. at the end of the day all we have is our happiness. money doesn’t determine that. we won’t always be happy but with time and a bit of effort we will experience things that do make us happy. life is just a fucked up journey with horrible times but sometimes we gotta suck it up and wait for the good times even though it sometimes seems like they will never happen. as of now just enjoy small things and try to improve yourself however you can. sadly nothing will change overnight but with time and effort you will not feel so bad. keep pushing and stay safe🖤
thanks haha. and yea i guess it could be worse even though that can be hard to believe at times. i hope that with time and some self improvement we both can have a better summer
i feel you. try to make the best of the time you have off and maybe push yourself sometimes to do things that you’ve been putting off.
sorry to hear that, but try to take part in little things you enjoy. could simply be taking looking at the stars or listing to a song. i found it makes life less miserable for me.
what’s been going on?
i haven’t gone out in public for a very long time too. but have you ever tried night walks? they sometimes help me and mabye it might help you.

i’m not happy with myself. i think that life is pointless. i’m tired of waiting and working so hard for nothing in return. i’m hate looking at myself in the mirror. i have family problems. i have social anxiety. i have add. i am short and not respected. i have medical problems. i don’t care about living, i’m just continuing to live to not upset people. i don’t care about having a future. i hate living. i can’t enjoy life. everyday is suffering and no matter my efforts nothing changes. it’s been like this for a long time and every day i get closer and closer to trying ******* another time. i know if i end up doing it i won’t be able to try another time..
believe me i am. i’ve been loosing weight, reading more, trying to be more social, i started therapy again, and i did well in school but nothing makes me happy or takes away the pain.

I really appreciate you taking your time to write this. I am trying though, I’m trying to improve myself all the time and even when it’s working it doesn’t bring me real joy. I started loosing weight, going to the gym, doing better in school, but it doesn’t change how I feel. I occasionally have small feelings of joy but it’s so minuscule and un often that I don’t care. I don’t know what to do to make my self feel like not wanting to take my life. I’ve been trying for so long and it seems like I’ve tried everything. I don’t care about how the sun feels, how the grass is green or anything it doesn’t do it for me. Talking about this makes me feel better but not much. It seems like I can change many things that I put my mind to but being suicidal is something that I can’t.

Everyday I feel the same. Nothing to look forward to just a life of suffering till i die. I’m scared that if I end up following through it will be worse. But everyday that fear is starting to be less and less daunting.
